name.en: Stud (hanger) bolt fixing for corrugated fibre-cement roofs and timber substructure (K2 HangerBolt CR / solar fastener type)
name.es: Fijación con espárrago (hanger bolt) para cubiertas de fibrocemento ondulado y subestructura de madera (tipo K2 HangerBolt CR / solar fastener)

description.en: Stainless or aluminium hanger (stud) bolts pass through the corrugated fibre-cement covering (through the crest) into the timber or steel substructure. A sealing ring or washer with EPDM or fibre-cement seal keeps the roof watertight. A climber or adapter plate carries the rail. Reference family: K2 Systems HangerBolt CR (SingleRail system) and solar fastener / hanger bolt range M10 and M12 for fibre cement, sheet and timber.
description.es: Espárragos de acero inoxidable o aluminio atraviesan la cubierta de fibrocemento ondulado (por la cresta) y se anclan en la subestructura de madera o acero. Una arandela o anillo de sellado con EPDM o sello de fibrocemento garantiza la estanqueidad. Un adaptador o placa sostiene el riel. Familia de referencia: K2 Systems HangerBolt CR (sistema SingleRail) y gama de espárragos y solar fasteners M10 y M12 para fibrocemento, chapa y madera.

typical_use: Corrugated fibre-cement roofs on timber or steel substructure; solar fasteners also used on trapezoidal sheet and sandwich panels (see the trapezoidal and sandwich families).
applicable_standards: EN 1995-1-1 (timber design, designer; not verified in this research)
Fibre-cement roof product standards (not verified in this research)

grounding_bonding: Grounding hardware for this system was not found in the K2 hanger bolt or HangerBolt CR manuals reviewed. Bonding must be obtained from the manufacturer or designed per the local standard.
installation_notes: Pre-drill 14 mm for M10 hanger bolt in corrugated fibre cement; 15 mm for M12 (K2 manuals).
Pre-drill 7 mm (M10) or 8.5 mm (M12) into timber substructure.
Minimum screw-in depth M10 40 mm; M12 48 mm (K2 hanger bolt manual).
Thermal separation at most every 17.6 m with a gap of at least 30 mm (K2 CR manual).
Rail end to module frame at least 50 mm; rail cut length at least 700 mm; module block spacing at least 5 mm (K2 manual).

Torque: upper self-locking nut 32 Nm; module clamps 14 Nm; rail joint 16 Nm; cross bracing 16 Nm (K2 CR manual). Solar fastener M10 installation torque 16 Nm for module clamps and SingleRail mounting, 35 Nm for rail connection (K2 manual).
